facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility

response.justification: MOC-2021-0030 was raised at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility on 9 February 2021 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including INC-2012-004 and INC-2025-010. The management of change record covers 1 clause across 4 controlled documents. The intent is to replace an existing requirement with one written to the current house style. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2016-007, MOC-2026-0413, PRO-MEC-014 and PRO-OPS-032.
